## Contract review

Local-runs: none

Read: card #33103 (body, triage `6852910908`, claim `6884287767`, os-dev-report `6885175870`), PR #33485 body and its 14-file list, and the net diff `9499dcc5..8a3b16e6` (merge base `9499dcc5` = the main the dev measured on; `git diff --stat` equals the PR file list). The face comes from the paths: `--paths` decides no face and hands it to the changeset's `Clause-②:` line, which carries no `(narrowing)` arm. That makes it the declaration face, `TIER_DEFAULT`, with no ④.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@object-ui/i18n` public surface: one added key, right.** `appManagement.alreadyDefault` lands in all eleven shipped packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, the full `src/locales/` set beside `index`/`registry`/`rtl`). Each sits next to `setDefaultNamed` and reuses that pack's own word for "default". No key is removed, renamed or reworded. This is a purely additive widening of a published package (`files[]` ships `dist`).
- **`@object-ui/console` public surface: unchanged, right.** `SetDefaultStar` is module-private (not exported). The page's export `AppManagementPage` keeps its signature.
- **Accept set / behaviour of the control: right.** The star's name (`setDefaultNamed` with `{{name}}`), `title`, click handler and `disabled={processing || isDefault}` are byte-for-byte what they were, moved into the component. What the change adds:
  - for `isDefault` only, `aria-describedby` pointing at an `sr-only` reason;
  - a `tabIndex={0}` wrapper (`data-disabled-reason`) that opens the reason on hover and focus.
- **Reuses the existing pattern, right.** `useDisabledReason` and `DisabledReasonTrigger` are exported from `@object-ui/components` (`src/index.ts` L85–86 at head). The hook's contract says its first argument is the caller's own verdict, "never the OR it hands the control's `disabled` prop". The page passes `isDefault` alone, not `processing || isDefault`. That is the right reading: `processing` is the page's transient state, matching how `disabled-reason.tsx` treats an execution in flight. The second argument is an already-translated string, which `pickLocalized` returns as-is, so the generic `actions.notAvailableForRecord` fallback is never reached here.
- **Tests pin the claim, right.** The new file renders the real page, Radix tooltip and `I18nProvider`, and reads the expected sentences from the shipped packs. It has four reason pins (description on button and wrapper, hover, Tab focus, zh-Hans) and two controls (non-default star live with no reason; a write in flight disables without a reason). The dev reports an ablation of the hook argument (4 red, 2 green). That is consistent with the pins as written; I did not re-run it.
- No server, `packages/spec`, metadata-protocol or governed path is touched.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/33103-default-app-star-reason.md`: `@object-ui/console: patch`, `@object-ui/i18n: patch`. Both packages are published and both have moved source, so both entries are owed. No package is missed: `@object-ui/components` is only consumed.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is **right**. A new key on a published i18n pack widens a public surface, and nothing narrows. The line appears identically in the PR body, the claim and the changeset.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is **right**. A UI string pack is not the metadata protocol an author writes against.
- `patch` beside `Clause-②: yes` is **right** under maintainer ruling A (2026-10-21, on #25105, mechanized in `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`). The level follows `Metadata-protocol:`, and `none` grades every introduced entry `patch`. This supersedes the 2026-09-04 "Clause-② yes means at least minor" coupling. The `Check Changeset` run `132610230865` concluded **success** on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- os-dev-report `open_questions: []`, `out_of_scope_findings: []`, `security_findings: none`, `premise_still_valid: true` (re-measured on `9499dcc5`). Nothing to answer and nothing to escalate.
- The claim's declared lines (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`) equal the measured ones, so no claim amendment is owed. The file surface stayed inside the claim (page plus tests, eleven packs, root `.changeset/`).
- **Check-runs on the head, as read.**
  - Success: `Check Changeset` (`132610230865`), `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check PR Size`, `filter`, `Build UI Deps`, `Plan Test UI shards`, `Live E2E UI`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Auto Label`.
  - Skipped by path filter or opt-in: the core build/test/docs matrix, the dogfood shard, `UI Published Artifacts`, the upgrade harness and tarball smoke, both queue verdicts, `Schedule gate`.
  - **Pending (in_progress), not yet a verdict:**
    - UI tests and checks: `Test UI (1/16)` through `Test UI (16/16)`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`.
    - Lint jobs: `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, and the three `Lint · scoped ·` jobs.
    - Type-check jobs: `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · debt ledger`.
    - A second `Check Changeset` (`132610791391`, re-triggered).
  - No failure is shown. This verdict is on the contract. The merge still waits on these runs going green, and a red among them reopens it.
- Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract):
  - `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/disabled-reason.tsx` (outside the diff) lists the hook's consumers in its header and now misses the console's `AppManagementPage`. A one-line follow-up whenever that file is next touched.
  - The PR carries the auto-labels `documentation` and `tooling`, which do not describe a console/i18n fix. They are cosmetic for the board.

## 席位核对

Verdict: **ACCEPT** · head `8a3b16e6` · 2026-11-14T22:46Z

1. **Shape.** Draft → `main`, `Fixes #33103`. 14 files, +227/−13:
   - `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx` (a module-private `SetDefaultStar`)
   - a new rendered test, `AppManagementPage.defaultStarReason-33103.test.tsx`
   - one key, `appManagement.alreadyDefault`, in all eleven `@object-ui/i18n` packs
   - one root changeset (`@object-ui/console` + `@object-ui/i18n` patch)

   All of it is on the claimed surface (6884287767).
2. **Premise.** Re-measured by the dev on `9499dcc5`: the default app's star was disabled with no reason.
   - **The fix:** the star goes through the console's one disabled-reason pattern (`useDisabledReason` + `DisabledReasonTrigger` from `@object-ui/components`). The reason opens on hover and focus and is the accessible description of the button and its wrapper.
   - The hook is given `isDefault` alone. A write in flight (`processing`) still disables every star, without a reason, as the hook's contract asks.
   - The star's name, title, handler and `disabled` condition are unchanged.
   - **Pins:** four reason pins (description, hover, Tab focus, zh-Hans) and two CONTROLs (a non-default star is live with no reason; a write in flight disables with no reason). Ablation: 4 red, 2 green.
3. **Contract record.** PASS 6885212793 on this head: one additive i18n key, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `patch` right under ruling A.
4. **Gates on head `8a3b16e6`.**
   - All 66 check runs are `success` or `skipped`, including Test UI shards + aggregate, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Check Changeset and PR-body guards.
   - The dev's local `--ran` is 38/38, 0 UNRUN.
5. **Nits (no change asked).**
   - Inside `SetDefaultStar`, the local `reason` shadows the module's `reason()` helper. Harmless, but the next edit could rename it.
   - The header comment of `disabled-reason.tsx` lists the hook's users and does not yet name this page.
6. **K.** 32 first-parent commits since base `9499dcc5` ≥ 15, so I synced the base before landing. The landing waits for the rerun to go green.
7. **Out of scope.** None.
8. **Authority.** Landing under the maintainer's standing authorisation 「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」 (2026-10-25T11:35Z).
